notes: Snapshot: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary product: in-app product analytics + behavioral cohorts. Heavy real-time recommendation/reranking and conversational insights for customer success agents.
Initial interest: started with hosted API (Jan 2026 trial), moved to Dedicated after latency spikes during internal load test and need for network isolation.

POC summary: 2-week POC (Feb 8-22). Focus: chat assistant for CS (latency target 120ms p50 for short prompts), embeddings for search (bulk embed throughput 10k/min), reranking for in-app recommendations. Ran against 13M token corpus, used model family rdx-3b-quant and fallback to hosted high-cap model for degraded quality tests.

Engineering feedback: runtime stable, KV cache cut token cost ~28% in our test; sustained throughput on dedicated pool met target. Noted a spike in 95th pct latency under burst load — ops wants clearer pre-warming/auto-scale docs.

Security/legal: security team completed SOC2 questionnaire (link above). Open items: DPA needs data residency clause for EU customers and stricter deletion retention windows. Legal redlining on MSA: indemnity and limitation of liability, termination for convenience, and SLA credits language.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-26): 'We need predictable tail latency and an auditable data path — if you can't provide residency for EU data we can't proceed with Dedicated.'

Pricing talks: Redwood provided Dedicated tier TCO estimate (annual commitment) — initial sticker $140k/yr incl. reserved capacity + ops add-on. Peregrine wants 15-20% discount tied to SLA minimums and 12-month commit. Procurement pushed back on overage rates for bursting beyond reserved capacity.

Commercial rhythm: AE (Marcus) shared pricing deck and draft MSA 2026-02-28. Peregrine returned redlines 2026-03-03 (Gmail thread). Legal suggests 7 business days turnaround; Redwood legal flagged 3 major clauses.

Operational readiness: Ops requested runbook for model upgrades, canary rollout steps, and rollback SLAs. SE (Nina) to deliver architecture diagram of VPC peering and network ACLs and mapping of encryption-at-rest keys to their KMS provider (scheduled 2026-03-08).

Onboarding plan: proposed 30-day onboarding with dedicated onboarding lead, two knowledge-transfer sessions, and a one-week performance validation window. Peregrine requested a sandbox with production-like traffic for final sign-off.

Risks: procurement timeline tight (wants procurement complete by 2026-04-15). Major risk is legal not settling indemnity and data residency language in time; also integration with their Okta SSO needs certificate exchange (pending).

Next steps captured: 1) Marcus to upload Redwood redline response (MSA/DPA) by 2026-03-07. 2) Legal-to-legal call week of 2026-03-09 to resolve indemnity and SLA credits. 3) SE (Nina) to provide network/KMS runbook + sandbox access details 2026-03-08. 4) Final commercial term sheet sent on 2026-03-10 for signature.
Short Jira references: RED-4319 = POC performance regression investigate; RED-4442 = sandbox environment provisioning request.
